UEFA Nations League Draw Live Stream: Kickoff Time, How to Watch & Event Preview

Match Overview

The UEFA Nations League draw ceremony is scheduled for 20 November 2026 with a kickoff time of 11:00 GMT. This event will determine the pairings for the knockout phase of the competition, including the quarter-finals, semi-finals, and potential promotion/relegation play-offs. The draw will involve the group winners and runners-up from League A, as well as teams from Leagues B, C, and D depending on the competition format. The venue for the draw ceremony has not been confirmed by UEFA at the time of writing.

Based on the current League A Group 1 standings, France finished top with 13 points (4 wins, 1 draw, 1 loss), Belgium placed second with 12 points (4 wins, 2 losses), Italy finished third with 10 points (3 wins, 1 draw, 2 losses), and Turkey finished bottom with 0 points from six matches. The group winners and runners-up from all League A groups will enter the quarter-final draw, while third-placed teams face promotion/relegation play-offs against League B runners-up.

Fixture Details

DetailInformation
EventUEFA Nations League Draw
Date20 November 2026
Kickoff ET06:00
Kickoff PT03:00
Kickoff GMT11:00
Kickoff CET12:00
Kickoff AEDT22:00
VenueNot confirmed
CompetitionEurope - UEFA Nations League
RoundKnockout stage draw

Why This Match Matters

This draw ceremony sets the bracket for the UEFA Nations League knockout phase. The four League A group winners will be seeded and drawn against the four group runners-up, with the restriction that teams from the same group cannot meet in the quarter-finals. The quarter-final ties will be played over two legs in March 2027, with the winners advancing to the Final Four tournament in June 2027. Additionally, the draw will determine the promotion/relegation play-off matchups between League A third-placed teams and League B runners-up, League B third-placed teams and League C runners-up, and League C third-placed teams and League D runners-up. The outcome directly shapes each nation's path to the Nations League title and their league status for the next edition.

Turkey managed 4 goals scored and 15 conceded (0.67 scored, 2.50 conceded per game). France enters the draw on a two-match unbeaten run (W-D), Belgium lost their last group game, Italy won their last two, and Turkey lost all six matches.

Belgium: Romelu Lukaku, Leandro Trossard, and Loïs Openda featured prominently in Belgium's attack during the group stage. Specific goal and assist tallies for the current Nations League campaign were not available at the time of writing.

How to Watch

Broadcast availability for the UEFA Nations League draw ceremony depends on local rights holders. In the United Kingdom, UEFA draw events are typically shown on UEFA's official website and YouTube channel, and sometimes on TNT Sports or BBC Sport. In the United States, Fox Sports and FuboTV have carried previous Nations League draws. In Germany, DAZN and RTL have broadcast rights for UEFA national team competitions. In Spain, Movistar+ and UEFA's platforms are common broadcasters. In Australia, Optus Sport holds UEFA rights. Viewers in other regions should check local listings or UEFA.com for official streaming links closer to the event date.

Draw Procedure & Seeding

The quarter-final draw will feature eight teams: the four League A group winners (seeded) and the four group runners-up (unseeded). A seeded team will be drawn against an unseeded team, with the seeded team playing the second leg at home. Teams from the same group cannot be drawn against each other. The semi-final draw will follow, determining the bracket path to the Final Four. The promotion/relegation play-off draws will pair League A third-placed teams with League B runners-up, League B third-placed teams with League C runners-up, and League C third-placed teams with League D runners-up, with the higher-league team hosting the second leg.

Teams Involved in the Draw

League A Group Winners (Seeded for Quarter-Finals): France (Group 1), plus the winners of Groups 2, 3, and 4. League A Runners-Up (Unseeded): Belgium (Group 1), plus the runners-up of Groups 2, 3, and 4. League A Third-Placed Teams (Promotion/Relegation Play-Offs): Italy (Group 1), plus the third-placed teams from Groups 2, 3, and 4. League A Fourth-Placed Teams (Relegated): Turkey (Group 1), plus the bottom teams from Groups 2, 3, and 4. The complete list of qualified teams from all groups will be confirmed before the draw ceremony.

Live Updates and Highlights

The draw ceremony will be streamed live on UEFA's official website and YouTube channel. Post-draw analysis and reaction videos will be available on the same platforms. Major sports news apps will provide real-time updates on the pairings as they are announced. This page can be bookmarked for post-draw summaries and the confirmed knockout stage schedule once published.

  • Q: What time does the draw ceremony start? A: The UEFA Nations League draw begins at 11:00 GMT on 20 November 2026 (06:00 ET, 03:00 PT, 12:00 CET, 22:00 AEDT).
  • Q: Where is the draw taking place? A: The venue for the draw ceremony has not been confirmed by UEFA.
  • Q: Which teams are in the quarter-final draw? A: The four League A group winners (including France) are seeded; the four runners-up (including Belgium) are unseeded. The full list depends on the remaining group results.
  • Q: Where can I watch the draw live? A: The draw will be streamed on UEFA.com and UEFA's official YouTube channel. Check local broadcasters for televised coverage.

Al-Ahli vs Al Nassr Live Stream: Kickoff Time, How to Watch & Match Preview

Match Overview

Al-Ahli welcome Al Nassr to the King Abdullah Sports City in Jeddah on Friday, 20 November 2026, with kickoff scheduled for 17:30 UTC. The fixture is part of the 2026-27 Saudi Pro League season and pits the league's sixth-placed side against the third-placed team. Al-Ahli enter the match on a four-match winning run in the league, while Al Nassr have lost only once all season and sit level on points with second-placed Al Quadisiya. Both teams have scored 28 goals in 11 matches, though Al Nassr have conceded significantly fewer (11 against Al-Ahli's 19).

The reverse fixture in April 2026 ended in a 2-0 victory for Al Nassr, but Al-Ahli won the corresponding home meeting in January 2026 by a 3-2 scoreline. With both sides in strong attacking form, the match carries implications for the top-four race and potential AFC Champions League qualification spots.
